details.groundedness_reasoning: Citation [4] gives 269,000 VND for “Dau’s Signature Bun Dau Mam Tom,” but does not establish that this is the same item as “Special Homemade Bun Dau.” Citation [9] describes “Special Homemade” but gives no price. The retrieved citations therefore do not sufficiently support the claimed 269,000 VND price.
